title: Engenheiro de API Gateway Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE API GATEWAY , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade assegurar que as plataformas de API Gateway do Cliente estão disponíveis e configuradas adequadamente para que os serviços de integração funcionem com alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Conhecimento no setup e utilização de soluções de API/Event Gateway + API/Event Management (Apigee, Kong, Gravitee, etc.);
  • Experiência com Git e pipelines CI/CD (Argo CD, Github Actions, etc.);
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de observabilidade;


e iremos olhar com muito bons olhos se também atender estes requisitos valorizados

  • Experiência em ambientes com elevado volume de transações e integrações

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma posição Full Remote , atuando com equipes do Cliente baseados em Portugal e é específica para quem reside no Brasil (em qualquer cidade ou estado).

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

Modelo: remoto

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.

  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição:


Buscamos um(a) Analista Contábil Sênior para atuar de forma estratégica na área de Controladoria , com forte interface com operações e áreas de negócio. Esta posição é responsável por garantir a integridade das informações contábeis relacionadas a estoques e ativos fixos , apoiando o fechamento mensal e assegurando conformidade com normas contábeis, políticas internas e controles corporativos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a acuracidade contábil dos estoques por meio de análises, conciliações, fechamento e reporte das contas.
  • Analisar e acompanhar contas transitórias de ativo fixo, assegurando correta classificação, capitalização e aderência às políticas contábeis.
  • Atuar no processo de capitalização de ativos fixos, incluindo controle e acompanhamento de autorizações de investimento.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar inventários físicos de estoques e ativos fixos, garantindo alinhamento entre registros físicos e contábeis.
  • Apoiar a análise de gastos, avaliando a correta classificação entre despesas e ativo imobilizado.
  • Analisar, reportar e discutir variações de inventário junto à liderança da área, contribuindo com análises críticas e recomendações.
  • Atuar em parceria com unidades operacionais e áreas de negócio, apoiando trâmites internos, controles e processos fiscais.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos de Controladoria, controles internos e boas práticas contábeis, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis , com CRC ativo
  • Sólida experiência em contabilidade geral e contabilidade aplicada a operações
  • Vivência consistente com estoques, inventários, ativos fixos e fechamento contábil mensal
  • Conhecimento de ambientes operacionais e processos produtivos
  • Excel em nível intermediário a avançado


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais de maior complexidade
  • Vivência em empresas de grande porte ou multinacionais
  • Perfil analítico, crítico, organizado e orientado a processos e controles

title: Fully Remote Personal Assistant
description:
Fully Remote Personal Assistant
Connect With Us:
  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com


This position is fully remote but we prefer LATAM or candidates who can work on EST schedule. 9am EST - 5pm EST.


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials 

We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue.  Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:
  • Customized Strategy Over Cookie-Cutter Systems : We build strategies tailored to each client instead of throwing everyone into the same system and seeing who survives
  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : Your videos are helping multi-million dollar businesses generate leads and sign more clients.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):

Execute admin and operational tasks with accuracy and minimal oversight so the CEO can focus on strategy, client relationships, and growth. You handle the repeatable, system-dependent work that frees up 10-15+ hours per week of founder time.

The Role: Virtual Assistant (part-time)

Core Responsibilities:


  • Lead Management & Qualification
  • Qualify and organize lead lists using defined criteria
  • Research leads and input into CRM
  • Maintain list hygiene and update status
  • CRM Management
  • Data entry and updates (contact info, lead status, pipeline stage)
  • Research prospect information as needed
  • Generate reports and organize client data
  • Project & Task Management
  • Maintain project management system with current status
  • Update calendars and task tracking
  • Flag blockers and keep everything on schedule
  • Job Applicant Processing
  • Organize and track incoming resumes
  • Update applicant spreadsheets and systems
  • Send templated emails and follow-ups
  • Content Operations
  • Post client videos to scheduled platforms per calendar
  • Track posting schedule and deadlines
  • Ensure all uploads are properly titled and organized
  • Email & Outreach Operations
  • Send templated outreach sequences
  • Track follow-ups and response rates
  • Maintain lists for ongoing campaigns


Your Operating Principles:

  • Follow written SOPs for all tasks
  • Ask clarifying questions only when instructions are genuinely ambiguous (not as your first instinct)
  • Complete tasks with minimal oversight and QA revisions
  • Flag process improvements when you see them, but execute as-written first


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

✅ Competent & Smart - Can read an SOP, understand the intent, and execute it correctly. If a non-competent person and a competent person get the same instructions, the competent person comes back with zero questions and zero errors. You're that person.

✅ Detail-Oriented - You catch your own mistakes before submitting. You're accurate on first attempt (not \"close enough\").

✅ Able to Learn Quickly - New tool? New task type? You figure it out. You can absorb written instructions and apply them without constant hand-holding.

✅ Independent Worker - You don't need constant check-ins or motivation. You show up, execute, and report results.

✅ Reliable - You hit deadlines consistently. Your week-to-week output is predictable.


Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

❌ Need constant hand-holding or detailed explanations for simple tasks 

❌ Prone to careless mistakes or inconsistent quality 

❌ Make excuses instead of solving problems 

❌ Lack systems thinking (can't prioritize across multiple task types) 

❌ Unreliable or inconsistent availability


You're Perfect If You:

  • Take pride in doing small things well
  • Enjoy organized systems and clear processes
  • Have experience managing multiple priorities without much oversight
  • Don't need someone to explain why the work matters (you get it)
  • Have worked as a VA, operations coordinator, or similar role before


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • $1,000-$1,500 per month (based on experience and performance)
  • $2,000-$3,000: If moved to full-time
  • Flexible hours: 15-20 hours/week, can expand as needed


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere with a laptop and internet
  • Direct communication with founder
  • Growth potential - if you're excellent, hours can increase as we scale


Our Values: The DNA of GP Socials


⚡ Speed - Speed creates room for unavoidable errors. We move fast, test quickly, and iterate relentlessly.

Ownership - Everyone makes mistakes, but we'll go further when we own them and learn from them. No excuses, just solutions.

Grit - The more hits you can take, the more unstoppable you become. We embrace challenges as opportunities to prove what we're made of.

Excellence - Good isn't good enough. We're doing operations right, and that requires excellence in everything we do.

(Include the number of the value that resonates most with you in your application)


The Process: Fast, Transparent, Respectful


We know your time is valuable. Here's exactly what to expect:

  • Apply with resume + 2-minute Loom video (details below)
  • Skill Assessment - Complete a lead qualification task (30 min)
  • Quick Call with Braden - Expectations discussion, your questions answered
  • Offer within 5 business days of final interview


Ready? Here's How to Stand Out:


Apply Here: ( )


Include:


  • Your resume/LinkedIn and any examples of admin/operations work you've done
  • A 2-minute Loom video covering:
  • Your biggest admin/operations win (what did you accomplish, what impact did it have)
  • Why GP Socials specifically (be specific - not just \"I need a job\")
  • The core value from above that resonates most with you and why
  • Optional but impressive: A 1-page case study showing your process and results - how you improved an operations workflow, what you diagnosed, and what happened


The Skill Assessment (What to Expect in Round 2):


If you advance, we'll give you:

  • A CSV of leads with scattered data quality
  • Clear qualification criteria (e.g., \"Business size $1-3M, active in last 30 days, has YouTube\")


You will deliver:

  • A cleaned list with qualified/disqualified labels
  • Notes on where data was ambiguous and your reasoning for edge cases
  • A brief explanation of your process


This shows us: Can you read criteria and apply judgment? Do you catch details? Do you understand the difference between unclear instructions and unclear data? Do you make reasonable calls on edge cases?


PS - A Personal Note from Braden Ricchini, Founder


This job isn't glamorous. You won't be building YouTube strategies or closing clients. You'll be qualifying leads, updating spreadsheets, and managing databases. But here's what matters: none of the exciting stuff happens without you. Every client onboarding, every lead that converts, and every efficient day is built from the work behind the scenes.


If you're the kind of person who takes pride in that, who understands that unglamorous work is actually the most important work, then we should definitely connect.


We're small, we're scaling fast, and you'll have a front-row seat to how a real business operates. No fluff, no fake promises. This is an opportunity to build operational systems that actually matter.


The question is, do you have what it takes?


If so, apply above.


— Braden


PPS: Still reading? That's the kind of attention to detail we need. Mention the word \"Easter Egg\" somewhere in your application for bonus points.

title: Unix Linux System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


  • Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments
  • Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux, HP-UX, Solaris, and AIX
  • Optimize system performance and availability
  • Coach and mentor team members
  • Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Hands-on experience in Linux and Unix systems
  • Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management
  • Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening
  • Familiarity with SAN/NAS, backup tools (TSM, VEEAM), and storage suites (EMC, NetApp, Hitachi)
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to work weekends and non-standard hours
  • Advanced English


Bonus Points:


  • Linux certification
  • German language skills
  • Experience with Veritas Cluster, Apache, DNS, DHCP, LDAP


Please submit resumé in English.

  • Desenvolver e manter sistemas utilizando a linguagem de programação C# e os frameworks .NET Framework ou .NET Core;

  • Experiência em Banco de Dados;
  • Experiência em React.

  • Lógica de programação;

  • Controle de versão com Git.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience


Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java , including microservices architecture using Spring Boot (mandatory);
  • At least 3 years of experience with Kotlin;
  • Fluent English (B2+) is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (1x on-site).


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;

Your next adventure starts here!

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Staff Engineer você será uma referência técnica transversal, com forte influência sobre decisões arquiteturais, padrões de engenharia e evolução da plataforma que sustenta todos os times de produto.

Você não estará focado em uma squad específica, mas sim em elevar o sistema como um todo: confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança, developer experience e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Influenciar e guiar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo da plataforma
  • Definir e evoluir padrões técnicos para serviços, infraestrutura, observabilidade e CI/CD
  • Atuar como guardião da qualidade técnica, reduzindo complexidade e dívida técnica
  • Trabalhar próximo a Tech Leads, SREs e Tech Managers, ajudando a desambiguar decisões difíceis
  • Projetar e evoluir plataformas e serviços compartilhados (infra, pipelines, templates, SDKs, ferramentas internas)
  • Garantir alta confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança dos sistemas em produção
  • Atuar fortemente em observabilidade, troubleshooting e resposta a incidentes críticos
  • Promover uma excelente Developer Experience, melhorando fluxos de build, deploy, testes e operação
  • Mentorar engenheiros(as) de diferentes níveis, elevando o padrão técnico da organização
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes, incrementais e sustentáveis
  • Tomar decisões orientadas por métricas, dados e impacto real no negócio


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida como engenheiro(a) sênior / staff / principal
  • Forte domínio em Node.js e Typescript.
  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos
  • Sólido conhecimento em Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Excelente domínio de observabilidade, troubleshooting e sistemas em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e mentoria
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas complexas equilibrando negócio, engenharia e operação


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Já atuou fortemente em times de plataforma ou SRE
  • Já trabalhou em projetos de grande porte utilizando Python
  • Tem experiência com arquiteturas event-driven
  • Conhece e aplica DDD, Clean Architecture e Ports & Adapters
  • Já liderou iniciativas transversais de engenharia
  • Consegue explicar decisões técnicas complexas de forma simples


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
  • PLR

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: SAP Fiori
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Dev BTP UI5 Fiori who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain BTP Fiori applications for SAP Dynamic Forms.

The ideal candidate will have 3–7 years of hands-on experience in SAP UI5 development and should be highly skilled in building responsive, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise applications.

SAP UI5 / Fiori: Strong experience in developing, customizing, and extending Fiori/UI5 applications

SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Hands-on experience with BTP services, particularly in application development and deployment

Frontend Development: Strong skills in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, XML

UI/UX Design: Experience creating responsive and user-friendly applications

OData Services: Proficient in consuming and integrating OData services; knowledge of SAP Gateway

Development Tools: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP Web IDE, Git

Version Control & CI/CD: Familiar with GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD pipelines

Performance Optimization: Ability to optimize UI5 apps for performance and scalability

Experience with CAP (Cloud Application Programming) Model on SAP BTP

Exposure to Node.js, REST APIs, or microservices architecture

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Understanding of security concepts (authentication, authorization in SAP BTP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

● English fluently

Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark

· • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications

Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements change.
  • Develop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified through testing

title: Líder Técnico III (React Native/NodeJS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar com liderança técnica de projetos de software, no Inatel Competence Center - ICC.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuar na definição de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade e desempenho;
  • Definir, documentar e validar arquiteturas lógicas e executáveis de sistemas;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, arquitetural, operacional e de apoio à gestão dos projetos;
  • Realizar especificação funcional e técnica de sistemas e aplicações;
  • Prover soluções e suporte ao desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicativos móveis e web;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível de complexidade técnica;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de QA, apoiando estratégias de testes e qualidade;
  • Revisar códigos-fonte, garantindo aderência a boas práticas, padrões de projeto e qualidade de software;
  • Projetar soluções com foco em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Atuar como referência técnica, promovendo capacitação, mentoria e suporte aos desenvolvedores;
  • Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar as atividades técnicas dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia, tais como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software ;


Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native , Expo e Node.js ;


Vivência com:

  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares);
  • Atuação em ambientes com cultura DevOps .
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web;
  • Design e definição de arquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend ;
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ;
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST ;
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Modelagem e documentação de projetos;
  • Ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código;


AWS (Amazon Web Services) , incluindo:

  • Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem;
  • Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway e CloudWatch;
  • Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade;
  • Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem.


Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) ;


Comunicação em rede CAN ;


Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play ;


Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy;


Testes automatizados;


Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design .

Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: as atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Analytics Engineer Pleno (CLT) | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira Analítica de Dados Pleno para compor o time de Engenharia Analítica do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.


Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.


Se interessou? Vem ser GranLover !

title: AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa de tecnologia focada em soluções digitais e inteligência artificial para o setor industrial, está buscando um(a) AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager para se unir a equipe:


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Liderar e desenvolver um time de Data Scientists.
  • Garantir planejamento, priorização e execução eficientes das iniciativas de dados e IA.
  • Atuar em parceria próxima com Produto e Engenharia para alinhar soluções técnicas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Contribuir de forma hands-on em experimentação, decisões de arquitetura e desenho de soluções de ML e IA.
  • Assegurar padrões elevados de engenharia e ciência de dados (reprodutibilidade, documentação e deploy).
  • Identificar oportunidades de uso de IA, traduzindo problemas reais em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, entrega incremental de valor e compartilhamento de conhecimento.


Quem buscamos:


Buscamos um profissional com formação em áreas de Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia, Matemática ou correlatas, experiência prévia liderando times de Data Science e forte atuação prática em Machine Learning, IA, Python e SQL. É essencial ter vivência no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções em produção, além de boa comunicação para interagir com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Inglês é obrigatório. Experiência com LLMs, cloud e/ou ambientes industriais será considerada um diferencial.

title: Design Executive
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


Client Relationship Growth Design Executive


Key responsibilities:


  • Assist in the creation and execution of visual assets for digital and print platforms, including websites, social media, emails, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, product, and sales) to produce design solutions that align with brand guidelines and business objectives.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to project specifications.
  • Maintain and organise design files, ensuring easy access and consistency across projects.
  • Adapt and optimise designs based on feedback from stakeholders, ensuring alignment with brand voice and vision.
  • Stay updated on design trends, tools, and techniques to contribute fresh ideas and innovative solutions to the team.
  • Assist with photo editing, typography, and layout adjustments as needed.
  • Create and edit video content and GIFs for social media, marketing campaigns, and web use.


Qualifications


To be successful in this role, you’ll have:


  • Qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong understanding of design principles, typography, colour theory, and layout composition.
  • Experience in creating and editing video content and GIFs using video editing tools.
  • Experience with 3D design and modelling software.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present ideas clearly.
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to manage time effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and respond well to constructive feedback.
  • A portfolio showcasing a range of design work across different mediums (please include with your application).
  • Great interest in the finance and trading industry.
  • Additional digital marketing skills are advantageous.



Perks

  • Young and talented team, and you will get full support from everyone.
  • We do great work, and you will be a part of the amazing journey.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack – PHP/JavaScript Júnior
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Júnior Full Stack para atuar em projetos estratégicos de sistemas corporativos. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções web, integrando tecnologias como PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript e PostgreSQL.

O candidato ideal possui experiência com sistemas de gestão administrativa, gestão de frotas, operação financeira bancária ou mercado de capitais. Conhecimentos adicionais em Visual Basic e Oracle serão considerados um diferencial.

  • Suporte à operação e evolução de sistemas existentes;
  • Colaboração com equipes de negócio para levantamento de requisitos e implementação de soluções.

  • Experiência em PHP, HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em projetos complexos, propondo soluções técnicas e inovações.


Desejável:

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.


The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.


Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.


Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).


Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;

title: DocuSign CLM Consultant
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests


Responsibilities:

  • Configure and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows, including fixes and new implementations
  • Provide global user support, responding to support cases and assisting end users
  • Perform governance activities, including workflow failure analysis and access reviews
  • Collaborate with and provide knowledge sharing among other CLM administrators


Experience:

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Desenvolvedor JAVA Sênior
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Código da oportunidade: 56985

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java, Springboot, mensageria, conceitos de devops, esteira CI/CD, terraform e AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
Software Developer / .net / C# / Microsoft technologies/ ASP / Designer / Software Engineer The Software Developer will work within a Development team, and may be involved in development of new products and maintenance of existing products including the design, installation, testing and maintenance of software systems


Senior Software Developer C#


What you’ll do


Participate in the migration and refactoring of a proxy solution from Golang to .NET, contributing to the evolution of legacy systems into modern architectures.

Design, develop and maintain cloud-native and edge computing solutions within the Restaurant Technology ecosystem.

Apply DevOps practices to cloud and edge deployments, including CI/CD automation.

Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and work closely with globally distributed engineering teams.

Ensure reliability, scalability and performance across both legacy and modern systems.

Understand complex existing systems and contribute to their continuous improvement.

Quickly learn and adapt to product and domain knowledge, supporting evolving business needs.



What we’re looking for


Solid experience with C# and .NET Core.

Experience working with cloud platforms and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.

Familiarity with edge computing environments and automated deployments.

Experience using gRPC for service-to-service communication.

Previous exposure to C++ is considered a plus.

Experience with Redis or similar in-memory data stores is a plus.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate in an international environment.

Good understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative development practices.


Personal skill


Strong problem-solving and ownership mindset.

Ability to work independently and in global teams.

Execute for results

Team player profile

Prompted pressure

Know how to solve problems in an effective manner

Share knowledge

title: Analista de Suporte à Gestão Ágil (SAFe / ARTs)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a vaga:


Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!


O que você vai fazer:


  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;
  • Elaborar artefatos, atas, relatórios e análises com base em dados extraídos de ferramentas de gestão ágil (burnup, burndown, OKRs, throughput, etc);
  • Apoiar na resolução de impedimentos e no acompanhamento de riscos e dependências;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento financeiro de épicos/features e alimentar sistemas integrados de gestão;
  • Suportar auditorias e controles (como SOX), mantendo a conformidade dos dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Colaborar com levantamentos de maturidade ágil, DevOps , e apoiar planos de ação de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com suporte à gestão em ambientes ágeis estruturados (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Conhecimento no framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) – desejável certificação ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão ágil e análise de dados operacionais (Jira, Excel avançado, etc);
  • Habilidade para comunicação, elaboração de apresentações e condução de reuniões.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for \"SAP ABAP Odata\" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief
